ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק רָצָה לְבָרֵךְ אֶת עֵשָׂו בְּנוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Isaac is old and cannot see well. He asks Esau to hunt and prepare food so Isaac can bless him before he dies.

ideas.children_he: רִבְקָה רָצְתָה שֶׁיַּעֲקֹב יְקַבֵּל אֶת הַבְּרָכָה.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca hears Isaac talking to Esau and tells Jacob to bring food so he can get the blessing instead of Esau.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִתְחַפֵּשׂ כְּדֵי לְהַטְעוֹת אֶת אָבִיו.
ideas.children_en: Jacob is afraid he does not look like Esau. Rebecca helps him dress up to trick Isaac and get the blessing.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁמַּסְתִּירִים אֶת הָאֱמֶת, אֲפִלּוּ אָדָם קָרוֹב עָלוּל לְהִתְבַּלְבֵּל.
ideas.children_en: Jacob pretends to be Esau. Isaac is unsure because Jacob's voice sounds different but blesses him because his hands feel hairy like Esau’s.

ideas.children_he: יִצְחָק סָמַךְ עַל מַה שֶּׁהִרְגִּישׁ וְלֹא יָדַע שֶׁהוּטְעָה.
ideas.children_en: Isaac asks Jacob again if he is Esau. Jacob gives food to Isaac, and Isaac eats and drinks before blessing him.
Isaac smells Esau’s clothes and blesses Jacob with blessings of good land and crops, giving Jacob honor over his brothers.

ideas.children_he: עֵשָׂו גִּלָּה שֶׁהַבְּרָכָה נִתְּנָה לְאָחִיו וְנֶעֱצַב מְאֹד.
ideas.children_en: Esau brings food and asks for a blessing, but Isaac tells him Jacob already got the blessing and Esau will not get it.
Esau is very angry and wants a blessing too because he feels Jacob tricked him twice, but Isaac says the blessing is already Jacob’s.
Isaac blesses Esau with less: good land but a life of struggle, and he will serve Jacob.

ideas.children_he: כַּעַס שֶׁלֹּא מְטַפְּלִים בּוֹ עָלוּל לַהֲפֹךְ לְאַלִּימוּת.
ideas.children_en: Esau hates Jacob and plans to kill him after Isaac dies. Rebecca knows or hears about this plan.

ideas.children_he: רִבְקָה רָצְתָה לְהָגֵן עַל יַעֲקֹב מִפְּנֵי הַסַּכָּנָה.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca tells Jacob to run away to her brother in Haran to be safe from Esau and stay until Esau’s anger passes.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב נֶאֱלַץ לַעֲזֹב אֶת בֵּיתוֹ בִּגְלַל הַמְּרִיבָה.
ideas.children_en: Rebecca is upset that Esau married daughters of Heth. She suggests Jacob marry from their own family far away.
